messages:
Marisol (CS): Hey team — kicking off onboarding for Stargate Labs (enterprise). Goal: get an initial pilot ingest -> inference loop running and validate against their 5 core flows. Please add any missing stakeholders and availability for a 30m call this week. Agenda: owners, success criteria, timeline, risks. Link to intake: https://redwood.app/onboard/SG-274 :rocket:
Rajiv (SE): thumbs up. Can you share what form the test data will be in? JSONL or batch CSV? Also need a service account to hit the hosted API for smoke tests.
Evelyn (Stargate AM): Hi — thanks Marisol. I'll be the primary from the customer side. They'll provide sample queries + labelled answers in JSONL. I'll loop in Tom (their eng) for data handoff. Available Thursday 10–11 PT.
Omar (Eng): For the integration: we'll likely want an IP allowlist + short-lived API key for the pilot. If they plan heavy throughput, we should know so we can advise on batching/quant and whether Dedicated capacity makes sense.
Marisol (CS): Proposed 3-week cadence (can adjust):
```
Week 0: Kickoff + SSO/KYC + acceptance criteria sign-off
Week 1: Data handoff, test keys, smoke tests
Week 2: Pilot (sanity + eval) + fix list
Week 3: Ramp -> production + enablement session
```
Devon (PM): Can we lock success criteria here? I want measurable pass/fail so the pilot isn't subjective. Also flagging renewal milestone at month 9 — if we spot early adoption issues that's a renewal risk.
Marisol (CS): Suggested success criteria (pilot):
- Latency: 95p < 450ms for interactive flows
- Accuracy: F1 >= 0.78 on labelled eval set
- Stability: <1% error rate over 24h smoke run
- Operational: auth + logs visible in Console for team
Are these OK? :white_check_mark:
Evelyn (Stargate AM): Those look reasonable. Security review might take 10 business days (SAML + contractual). That's our main timeline risk.
Priya (Enablement): I'll own enablement deliverables. Preferred format? live walkthrough + recording, and a short one-pager. I can run the training during Week 3. Any devs want a deeper runbook?
Rajiv (SE): I can prepare a regression harness and need their test prompts (sample JSONL). Also can add a short script to measure latency and token cost.
Tom (Stargate Eng): @Evelyn / @Marisol — I'm Tom, I'll own the data side. I can deliver JSONL by Monday EOD. Also confirm: do you want schema + sample rows or full dataset?
Evelyn (Stargate AM): Schema + ~200 sample rows to start. We'll expand after pilot.
Marisol (CS): Noted. Risk: SAML + legal review may block production credentials. Mitigation: temp API keys + IP allowlist for pilot, then swap to SAML once approved.
Omar (Eng): Also asking: does Stargate want Dedicated from day 1? If not, we should set the routing policy to their region and a medium priority tier to avoid noisy-neighbor effects. Budget owner?
Devon (PM): Finance flagged that Dedicated needs a separate PO. For pilot we'll stay hosted. If pilot performance fails because of noisy neighbors, we'll circle back on Dedicated. Legal-bot: please surface the SAML SOW clause for expedited review (cc: @legal).
Marisol (CS): Great — next steps I have: 1) schedule 30m kickoff (Thu 10 PT) 2) Tom sends sample JSONL by Mon 3) we provision temp keys + allowlist 4) Priya schedules Week 3 enablement. I'll post the calendar invite and a short checklist in the thread. Anything else?
Evelyn (Stargate AM): All good from my side. Thanks everyone. Looking forward to Thursday. :handshake:
Tom (Stargate Eng): Confirmed — will upload samples to the secure bucket and share link by Monday.
Marisol (CS): Awesome — I'll follow up with the invite and the onboarding checklist. If anyone has blockers before the call ping me or drop updates here. :sparkles:
